meta.name: TCIA Histopathology Collections
meta.description: Image-level metadata for public pathology collections in The Cancer Imaging Archive (whole-slide images, TMAs, cytomorphology, multiplex and hyperspectral imaging). One record per image; a per-patient flag gives distinct patient counts.

data_access.instructions: Public metadata from TCIA PathDB; images are downloadable per collection from cancerimagingarchive.net (see each collection's DOI).
